description: Issue #90, the window the pre-flight cannot close: #200's directory IS a registered git worktree, so `worktrees_present` is satisfied by the `git worktree list` fallback and the pre-flight passes — but CommandMate has no row for it, so the wave-2 resolution finds no send target. Wave 1 dispatches and advances normally; wave 2 records #200 as failed with the unresolved note and stops as partial with stop_reason drift and a `worktree_unresolved` blocking reason, NOT `worker_failed`: no worker was ever started, so there is no worker log to read and nothing to re-plan.

200: worktree unresolved: no registered worktree matches branch
